name: Korean peninsula
summary: No North Korean missile launch found since 3 Nov; Kim vows more nuclear weapons, KCNA says on 26 Nov
state: KCNA said on 26 Nov that Kim Jong Un inspected two nuclear material production plants and called for low-yield battlefield nuclear weapons, after ignoring a US offer of talks (AP via TPR). Ukraine's military intelligence claimed on 26 Nov that North Korea had suspended military aid to Russia; neither side confirmed it (Euronews). No missile launch in the past two weeks, nuclear test or border clash was found to 28 Nov, so Normal holds.
for_you: No immediate change for travel or trade with South Korea or Japan. Travellers should follow FCDO travel advice.
rubric_hit: No missile launch in two weeks; no nuclear test or border clash
